descricao: Level 92 is a sprawling complex of winding tunnels that connect what appears to be underground bunkers from various decades. These rooms bear a resemblance to nuclear bunkers circa 1980, as well as bomb shelters from the World War 2 era. Level 92 is vast, although its exact size is unknown due to the dangers of long-term expeditions. Countless safe paths twisting through dozens of miles have been established over many years.
